name: qlrisk_price_cdo
title: Price a CDO
description:
Price one Collateralized Debt Obligation (qlrisk CDO).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, recovery_pct=40, correlation=0.3 (0 to 1), attachment_pct=3, detachment_pct=7, pool=GLOBEX, coupon_bp=300, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100} gives NPV 50.78 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
